insights.title: Performance loss up 14% over the last 5 shifts
insights.pattern: Motor current rises 20 to 30 minutes before each cycle slowdown.
insights.recommendation: Inspect the spindle motor and bearing before Shift 2 tomorrow.

insights.title: Material Late repeats at the 14:30 kanban run
insights.pattern: 9 of the last 12 Material Late stops started between 14:20 and 14:45.
insights.correlation: Warehouse shift handover overlaps the afternoon kanban route.
insights.recommendation: Move the Casting Line kanban run to 14:00 for two weeks and compare.

insights.title: Cycle time runs 15% above ideal after each wheel change
insights.pattern: Reduced Speed follows 6 of 7 polishing wheel changes and lasts about 40 minutes.
insights.correlation: Wheel run-in parameters are set by hand per operator.
insights.recommendation: Store the run-in recipe on the PLC and lock it per SKU.

insights.title: Camera faults cluster in the last hour of Shift 1
insights.pattern: 5 vision faults this week, all after 14:00.
insights.correlation: Afternoon sun on the inspection window raises the exposure error rate.
insights.recommendation: Fit the light hood that Line B already uses and re-teach exposure.
